description: This file contains the abstract class 'AbstractGrant' within the OAuth2 client library, defining common functionality for different grant types in OAuth2 authorization flows.

classes.name: AbstractGrant
classes.description: An abstract class representing a type of OAuth2 authorization grant, providing methods for handling grant parameters and string representation.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Abstract method to return the name of the grant type.

methods.name: getRequiredRequestParameters
methods.description: Abstract method to return the list of required request parameters for this grant.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the grant's name as its string representation for URL encoding.

methods.name: prepareRequestParameters
methods.description: Prepares and validates the request parameters for an access token request by merging defaults and options, then checking required parameters.
